slides.title: Blamed for something you *didn't* do?
slides.sub: What to say on board instead of firing back.

slides.title: Don't fight it mid-watch
slides.body: Not on the bridge, not in front of the crew. Ask for two minutes after the watch.

slides.title: Bring the record, not feelings
slides.body: Point to what's written: the log, the checklist, the handover notes. Facts settle it faster than emotion.

slides.title: Say it in one line
slides.body: "I see it differently. Can I show you what happened at 0230?" Calm, short, no accusation.

slides.title: End with the *next* time
slides.body: Ask: "What do you want me to do next time?" You keep your respect, and the next watch stays calm.

slides.b: Silence becomes the story. Say it once, calmly, in private.

slides.question: How do you handle blame on board?
slides.line: Built at sea by a serving 2nd Officer.
